name: au-primary-production
description: Use this skill to prepare Australian primary production workpapers for 2026-27 for individuals, partners and trust beneficiaries carrying on a farming, fishing or forestry business: whether a business of primary production is carried on (TR 97/11), income averaging under Division 392, farm management deposits under Division 393, livestock trading stock values, natural increase cost elections and forced disposal or death elections (Subdivision 385-E), and the special depreciation rules for water facilities, fencing, fodder storage, horticultural plants and landcare. Trigger on "primary producer", "farm management deposit", "FMD", "income averaging", "natural increase", "forced disposal of livestock" or "drought".
